Game Overview

Super Pizza Quest puts players into a platformer experience centered on embark on a hilarious quest to reclaim your stolen pizza from a greedy dragon. Traverse whimsical worlds and outwit quirky foes through action-packed levels. Collect coins, dodge hazards, and savor cheesy power-ups. With charming visuals and intuitive controls, Super Pizza Quest delivers platforming fun for everyone. Will you save pizza night?
